Hoopa Dungeon Guide

Pokémon Revolution Online — a player-tested walkthrough

How to unlock the dungeon

Recommendation: have the seen data of the Gen 6 Pokédex, for all Pokémon except the legendaries. Then go to Cherrygrove City in Johto. On the left side of the map there is a sailor, and he gives you access to Arche Valley. Complete the Arche Valley quest to unlock the Scattered Realms dungeon, also known as the Hoopa Dungeon.

General Information

Entry rules Player-recorded

1

1–5 players can enter the dungeon. Solo runs are possible.

2

Each player can enter twice per server day.

3

Each player can bring only 4 Pokémon.

4

Only Pokémon that belong to an evolution line can be brought: evolved or pre-evolved Pokémon that have an evolution. Pokémon with no evolution cannot be brought.

5

On entering, every Pokémon returns to its first evolution stage and becomes level 25. Movesets are also reset: only level-up moves and egg moves the Pokémon has learned are kept, and all other moves are reset.

Dungeon rooms Player-recorded

Wild Pokémon rooms

Each realm has several different rooms. Wild Pokémon appear in these rooms. Defeating them gives experience, which you can use to level up your Pokémon.

Treasure room

It gives TM moves, and the moves are random. It also gives items such as Max Potion, Max Revive, Max Elixir and others. You also get one extra Pokémon, which is random too.

Boss room

Defeating the boss in the boss room opens the Hoopa boss room.

The other two slots change with the realm. Choose those two Pokémon according to the realm you are running.

Quick overview

You pick 4 Pokémon, enter one of the four realms, clear its rooms, defeat that realm's boss, and then face Hoopa. The steps below are the same in every realm. What changes with the realm: the wild Pokémon in its rooms, the boss room, and the guardians in Hoopa's room.

Step by step Same in all 4 realms

  1. 1
    Prepare your team

    Bring 4 Pokémon, from evolution lines only. Gyarados and Scyther are compulsory (or your choice). The other two slots depend on your luck, because the realm is random. You can get any realm.

  2. 2
    Enter the realm
    • Every Pokémon becomes level 25.
    • Evolved Pokémon go back to their first stage and keep only the moves that stage knows. Gyarados turns into Magikarp, and its moves reset to what Magikarp knows.
    • Scyther does not change, because it is already a first-stage Pokémon (it needs a trade to become Scizor). If it has learned level-up and egg moves, it keeps them.
  3. 3
    Clear the wild Pokémon rooms and level up

    Each realm has several rooms, and the wild Pokémon are different in each realm. Defeat them to earn experience.

    Note: Each wild Pokémon gives XP only once. If you defeat the same Pokémon again, you will not get any XP.

    • Once Magikarp evolves into Gyarados, teach it the useful moves, like Waterfall and Dive.
    • Level up your Pokémon to 32+ for a smoother run in the boss fights.
    • After you defeat Pokémon, you get berries like Lum Berry, Leppa Berry and Sitrus Berry. They are useful for recovery.

    PP trick: Dive has only 10 PP. When Gyarados levels up, it can learn other moves, like Rain Dance. If Dive's PP is low, replace Dive with Rain Dance, then teach Dive again. Dive's PP will be full again. You can use this trick with other Pokémon too, to restore their PP.

  4. 4
    Visit the treasure room

    It gives TM moves, and the moves are random. It also gives items such as Max Potion, Max Revive, Max Elixir and others. You also get one extra Pokémon, which is random too, and you can use it inside the dungeon.

  5. 5
    Find and defeat the boss
    • The boss room can be in any place in the realm. It is random and different in each realm.
    • A message appears before you enter, so you know it is the boss room. Enter only when your team is ready and you are confident.
    • The boss comes with 3-4 other Pokémon. Defeat them first, then fight the boss.
    • Be fast. If you take too long, the defeated Pokémon spawn again. As soon as the last one faints, go straight to the boss.
    • After you defeat the boss, a portal to Hoopa opens. You can enter it.

    Tip: If a Pokémon has fainted, or HP or PP is low, you can go to the treasure room, use the items you saved there (like Max Potion and Max Revive), and come back. You will not have to defeat the boss again.

  6. 6
    Defeat the guardians, then Hoopa

    Hoopa Unbound stands in the middle of its room.

    Before you can fight it, you must defeat its guardian. The guardian depends on the realm you are in, and it is the same legendary as that realm's boss:

    • Psychic Realm: Palkia
    • Steel Realm: Dialga
    • Fire Realm: Groudon
    • Water Realm: Kyogre

    For example, if you fought Palkia in the boss room, the guardian in Hoopa's room is Palkia too.

    There are 3 phases in total. In the 3 phases you must defeat Hoopa (Unbound) 3 times, once in each phase. In each phase the Pokémon's levels go up, and they also become a little stronger.

    Experience: You get experience for defeating the guardian's Pokémon in every phase, but only once per phase. In one phase, each Pokémon gives experience only one time. After you defeat them, your own Pokémon's levels go up too.

    • After you defeat the guardian, you can fight Hoopa (Unbound).
    • After you defeat Hoopa (Unbound), you must repeat this 2 more times: defeat the guardian again, then fight Hoopa again.
    • Second round: Hoopa's punches are added to the map. They move around, and you must avoid them to reach the guardians.
    • Third round: the punches become faster, and some blockages (barriers) also appear. You must avoid those too.

    Note: Once you enter Hoopa's room, you cannot go anywhere else, so use the treasure room before you take the portal.

    Important If a punch hits you (the player), your Pokémon will lose health. So avoid the punches and defeat Hoopa.

What changes in each realm

The process above stays the same, but each realm has its own wild Pokémon, its own boss room and its own guardians with Hoopa. Tap a realm to see which Pokémon to use and how to beat its boss and guardians.

Psychic RealmPalkia
Steel RealmDialga
Fire RealmGroudon
Water RealmKyogre
Hoopa is different from the other bosses: the guardians in its room change with each realm. Open a realm and tap the bubbles to see how to defeat each guardian.

Tips

  • Gyarados and Scyther work in all four realms, so train them first.
  • Level Gyarados to 32 or higher, with Waterfall and Dive learned, before you look for the boss.
  • Fight the boss's 3-4 Pokémon quickly, then the boss, before they spawn again.
  • Save your treasure room items. After the boss, you can use them and come back through the portal without fighting the boss again.

Boss Room

Main Boss — Hoopa (Unbound)
  • First defeat the Pokémon of Shadow Palkia: Mismagius, Shadow Mega Alakazam and Mr. Mime. Then fight Shadow Palkia.
  • Against Mismagius, use Gyarados and give it the Choice Scarf item.
  • Against Shadow Mega Alakazam and Mr. Mime, use Mega Gyarados.
  • To defeat Shadow Palkia, use Gardevoir with Fairium Z.
